license_propagation_rule.BUILD_ONLY_TRANSIENT: Build-only inputs retain notice and source obligations but do not propagate into the runtime product image.
license_propagation_rule.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Diagnostic-only inputs require a separate SBOM and are excluded from formal images.
license_propagation_rule.LINKED_OR_DERIVED: Linked, patched, or compiled outputs require a derivation and notice review.
license_propagation_rule.RUNTIME_COPIED: Inputs copied into a runtime image are governed by the runtime license policy.
